title: Tiny, cute mobile phone
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- phone body -->
  <rect x='30' y='15' width='40' height='70' rx='9' fill='#3D6FC4'/>
  <!-- body highlight edge -->
  <rect x='32' y='17' width='36' height='66' rx='7' fill='#5A8EDC'/>
  <!-- screen -->
  <rect x='36' y='24' width='28' height='50' rx='4' fill='#1E2A3D'/>
  <!-- screen glow content: a little smiley app -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='9' fill='#7BE8FF'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='46.5' cy='40' r='1.8' fill='#1E2A3D'/>
  <circle cx='53.5' cy='40' r='1.8' fill='#1E2A3D'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M46 45 Q50 48.5 54 45' stroke='#1E2A3D' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- screen bottom bar -->
  <rect x='36' y='60' width='28' height='14' rx='3' fill='#2C4A78'/>
  <rect x='40' y='64' width='9' height='6' rx='2' fill='#FFD166'/>
  <rect x='51' y='64' width='9' height='6' rx='2' fill='#F97B9B'/>
  <!-- home button -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='79' r='3.2' fill='#7BE8FF'/>
  <!-- speaker slot -->
  <rect x='44' y='18.5' width='12' height='2.5' rx='1.2' fill='#2A4E8E'/>
</svg>
